verdict.rationale: Wrike's own materials confirm it has automation rules and no-code automations: the pricing page lists 'NL automation rule generation' and 'build no-code automations'. However, nothing in the pack describes the trigger-and-action structure, the available triggers or actions, or how rules remove repetitive steps. missing for 10: documentation of trigger and action types and rule configuration, details on rule scope, limits and plan availability, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can build trigger-and-action automation rules to eliminate repetitive manual steps

citations.quote: Connect Wrike to your apps, build no-code automations, and run end-to-end workflows from one secure platform.
Build workflows with Wrike agents and let them handle your everyday tasks.
